verdict.rationale: Proxy routing is a fair question for a hosted headless-browser platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents proxy IPs, IP rotation, or a proxy pool. CAPTCHA handling (docs-10) and network interception (docs-4) are adjacent anti-bot and network features, not proxy rotation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks
